asset: Practice manager's laptop with access to the patient records system
threat: Loss or theft of the device on the way between the practice and home
vulnerability: Disk not encrypted, sign-in without a second factor
planned_controls: Disk encryption on every mobile device, a second factor for the patient records system, a written rule for taking devices out
notes: The effect sits in the encryption. Without it the likelihood stays at 3.

asset: Appointment booking and billing at the software provider
threat: Outage at the provider or a ransomware attack on its data centre
vulnerability: No export of our own, recovery only through the provider
existing_controls: Contract with an availability commitment and a duty to report incidents
notes: Below the acceptance threshold of 9. The acceptance is reassessed yearly, because the dependency on the provider is growing.

threat: Action taken in someone else's name, access not attributable afterwards
vulnerability: One shared account for everyone at reception
existing_controls: The screen cannot be seen from the waiting area
planned_controls: An account per person, rights by role instead of full access
notes: The likelihood falls, the impact stays, because the same data remains reachable.

asset: Backup of the patient records system
threat: Data loss after a device failure, a handling error or a ransomware attack
vulnerability: The restore has never been tried and the backup disk sits in the same room as the server
existing_controls: Daily backup to an external disk
planned_controls: Try the restore every quarter and record the result, keep a second copy off site
notes: A backup with no tried restore is an assumption and not a control.
